title: Changes in Radicular Pain and Pain Modulation
brief_summary: The objectives of this study are: 1)To investigate the difference in pain modulatory mechanisms using quantitative sensory testing (QST) between healthy controls and patients with radicular leg pain due to nerve root compression. 2) To investigate the association between changes in radiating leg pain and pain modulation among the patient group.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Patient group

* Radiating leg pain due to nerve root compression verified by MRI
* Clinical findings in accordance with MRI findings
* Average leg pain ≥ 3/10 on a numeric pain rating scale Controls
* No current or previous history of ongoing musculoskeletal pain

Exclusion Criteria:

Applies for both groups.

* Other specific medical conditions e.g. rheumatologic disease, diabetes or vascular diseases.
* Pregnancy
